ACTION box under each week-screen panel: same width as the name tag.
Save/load angel menu items (rows 796-811 area): highlight bar 72 px at 6 px/letter; items are centred.

'Is this all right?' box after picking a hero (PSX.1579E0 これでよろしいですか？): the box shows only cells 4-11, the first 3 cells (これで) are hidden in the original too. English: 6 letters of padding/hidden lead-in, then at most 16 visible letters.
Yes/No under the confirm prompt (PSX.157FDC １．はい, PSX.157FE8 ２．いいえ): the 2-cell '１．' prefix is hidden; highlight bar ~85 px = 7 letters.

The player's angel name (save 0x204/0x19AE, 6 cells = 12 pair letters): scene name12_week shows ABCDEFGHIJ inside the week-screen tag, K on the border, L outside. Cap names at 10 letters (5 cells). The entry grid itself (PSX.EXE name-entry grid rows) is phase 7 work: it enters one code per cell, so it must produce pair codes.

FIN.EXE staff roll (DATA/STAFF.TXT): double-byte codes only (ASCII bytes hang it). Lines start at x=148 on the 320-px screen: 14 full-width letters, or 28 English letters as FIN pair codes (asm/fin.asm, phase 8); the Japanese indent of k full-width spaces is 2k letters. Never a leading '%' (x=64 mode): it stops the roll for good; two-name rows split into one line per name ('|').

EPILOG.EXE ending box (own renderer, hooked by asm/epilog.asm): lines start at x=110 (640-px screen) and the right limit is x~590, so 40 letters, as the dialogue box. Its first line in ending 3 starts 12 cells in (ruler 28 letters visible from x=256).
